tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find Wisty UI items by the job they do, best first. Each match gives its name, kind (primitive, component, block, helper) and description. A block is a finished section built from components and primitives over sample data, to install and edit: when the job is a whole section, start from its block,

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every Wisty UI item by kind, with its first sentence. Primitives are shadcn's own components with the Salesforce look; components are what shadcn lacks, like lookup; blocks are finished Salesforce sections over sample data; helpers turn records into a block's props. Prefer search_components whe

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Read one Wisty UI item to choose and compose it: its install command, examples by name, When to use, When not to use, Usage, Rules, API reference.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Get one example's code for a Wisty UI item, for the project's base: a complete, working use to adapt.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Get the steps to install one Wisty UI item: the shadcn command, and the theme and icon steps it needs. First read style and tailwind.css from the project's components.json, and whether it has a src/ folder; a project without components.json runs npx shadcn@latest init first.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_install_command" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
